---
title: "Contact"
---

## Email

The most reliable option is usually a direct email link.

- Email: <your.name@institution.edu>

## Contact form (optional)

If you prefer a contact form, a static website needs a form backend service. One approach is Formspree. Replace the form action URL with your own Formspree endpoint, and consider adding basic spam protection.

<form action="https://formspree.io/f/yourFormId" method="POST">
  <label>
    Your name<br>
    <input type="text" name="name" required>
  </label>
  <br><br>
  <label>
    Your email<br>
    <input type="email" name="email" required>
  </label>
  <br><br>
  <label>
    Message<br>
    <textarea name="message" rows="7" required></textarea>
  </label>
  <br><br>
  <button type="submit">Send</button>
</form>

<p class="small-note">
If you enable a contact form or analytics, add a short privacy notice describing what data is collected, where it is processed, and how long you retain it.
</p>
